statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness
There is concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and other unspecified cardiac arrhythmias
A 48-hour Holter monitor, CPT code 93226, was ordered
The Holter monitor was ordered to capture the rhythm during symptomatic periods and assess the burden of arrhythmia
The diagnosis codes I48.0 and I49.9 were assigned
The service was denied with reason code PR-204
The 48-hour Holter monitor is medically necessary
